B1.note: 111-112 aa, translated from an internal AUG on subgenomic RNA3, IN FRAME with protein A and sharing its stop codon (PMID 36560822: 'its open reading frame matches the 3-prime termini of the RdRp reading frame'). An anti-necrotic death factor (PMID 19136133). ITS START CODON HAS NEVER BEEN PUBLISHED and no RefSeq annotates a B1 CDS anywhere in the genus, so BV-BRC holds only 2 deposits across 1,456 genomes. The collection was built by extraction from the genomes under the one property the literature does fix -- that B1 is in frame with A and shares its stop -- so an accepted member must be an exact C-terminal substring of protein A from its own genome. 124 of 124 testable extractions passed. Identity still does the quality work at -mi 0.8; the member count was only asking whether a profile can be built at all. upstream_ext is 0, NOT 1. B1 lies ENTIRELY INSIDE the protein A reading frame, so there is no stop codon upstream of its start for scan_to_met_start to halt on: with upstream_ext 1 the scan walks left in 3-nt steps through protein A until it reaches an arbitrary Met. Measured on Flock House virus NC_004146 on 22 Nov 2026, that called B1 at 2620..3036 = 138 aa where GenBank annotates 2728..3036 = 102 aa -- the scan had run 36 codons past the real start. This is the same defect the skill records for Norovirus mature peptides, in a CDS rather than a polyprotein. With upstream_ext 0 the start is the profile's own match extent, and the profile is trained only on members whose start sits exactly at the aligned reference start. EXTRACTION uses --met-slack 0, so an accepted member's start sits exactly at the aligned reference start: 116 members at 110-112 aa, against the 111 aa (336 nt) of PMID 19136133. CP.note: 338-340 aa, a SINGLE UNCLEAVED CHAIN. This is the feature that separates the module from Alphanodavirus: PMID 9672600 showed the RNA2 ORF 'carries the catalytic D-75 residue but lacks the site for autocatalytic proteolysis, the process yielding the two capsid proteins of insect nodaviruses', and ruled out alternative initiation, a -1 frameshift and precursor degradation as explanations for the 43/45 kDa doublet. The T=3 crystal structure is built from the intact 338-residue chain (PMID 26491970). NO beta or gamma mature peptides are declared here, deliberately.
